headline: FFO tops guidance on leasing strength; impairment hits EPS
summary_short: BXP's Q2 2026 revenue rose 3.1% y/y to $895.7M and FFO per share grew to $1.78 (+4.1% y/y, beating guidance by $0.08), but diluted EPS fell to $0.43 from $0.56 a year ago on a $0.10/share non-cash impairment tied to the planned Sumner Square sale.
summary_long: Revenue grew 3.1% y/y to $895.7M on higher occupancy. Diluted EPS fell to $0.43 from $0.56 a year ago and missed guidance by $0.02, driven by an $18.0M ($0.10/share) non-cash impairment on the planned Sumner Square disposition, partly offset by $0.08/share of higher occupancy-driven revenue and lower operating expenses. FFO rose to $1.78/share from $1.71, beating the guidance midpoint by $0.08 on the same revenue and expense tailwinds. BXP executed 1.8M SF of leases, lifting total portfolio occupancy 100bp q/q to 88.4%, and closed a $1.2B construction loan for 343 Madison Avenue. Full-year 2026 guidance: EPS midpoint cut $0.03 (impairment); FFO midpoint raised $0.05 (operating outperformance).
